commits.author: rjpower
commits.message:
[finelog] Prune key trigrams before log data (#9310)

Check range-constrained trigram columns first and stop reading a
segment's index sections when no spans remain. Job-prefix log searches
can reject a segment with the small `key` index before opening its
larger `data` index. The SQL predicate still checks surviving rows.

On the federated `log` table, a representative prefix overlaps about 669
catalog segments. Key trigram pruning leaves about 60 candidates, while
the initial set advertises about 1.1 GB of `data` index payload. Before
this change, `EXPLAIN` took about 10 seconds; `EXPLAIN ANALYZE` scanned
3.3 MB of Parquet in about 90 ms. Production latency after deployment
remains unmeasured.

Remove the obsolete Finelog corpus assertion for the accelerators
dashboard, whose queries now run through bounded Grafana endpoints with
coverage in the Grafana suite.

commits.author: loom-oa-dev[bot]
commits.message:
[marina] Add public applet sharing (#9305)

Allow applet owners and configured Marina operators to set `--mode
public`
during publish or update, or change only the mode with `marina applets
mode`.
Public applets receive share URLs under `public.applets.marina.oa.dev`.
A
separate unauthenticated Cloud Run service accepts only GET and HEAD
requests
under `/a/`; publishing, lifecycle controls, SQL queries, and non-read
backend
requests remain on the IAP-protected service.

Public mode assumes trusted applet code and unrestricted data. A GET
backend
still runs with the applet database role and service credentials and can
cause
side effects. Applets remain private by default, and updates preserve
the
existing mode unless `--mode` is supplied.

Deploy the `marin-marina` stack first so the public Cloud Run service
exists.
Then review and apply the `marin` stack's `allUsers` invoker grant
through the
`review-grant` workflow; applying that grant before service creation
fails.

commits.author: marin-ops-agent[bot]
commits.message:
Delete unused Dolma validator, dead jax shim, and duplicate state sets (#9249)

Three unrelated deletions of code that no longer does anything.

`marin/validate/validate.py` validated Dolma-format `documents/` trees
and wrote
a dataset-level `metadata.json`. Nothing has called it since it was
added in
September 2024 (#244): no experiment, step, test, doc, or console script
references it, and no consumer reads the metadata it produced. The
datakit's
`ingestion_manifest.py` covers dataset metadata for the Parquet
pipeline.
Deleting it leaves `write_provenance_json` as the only live symbol in
`marin/utilities/validation_utils.py`, so that module moves to
`marin/utilities/provenance.py` and the five helpers used only by the
deleted
script go with the script.

`levanter` resolved the `shard_map` correctness-check kwarg at import
time in
three modules, each computing `"check_vma" if "check_vma" in
inspect.signature(shard_map).parameters else "check_rep"`. Levanter pins
`jax>=0.9.2,<0.12`, and `jax.shard_map` exposes `check_vma` with no
`check_rep`
parameter at both ends of that range, so the fallback branch is
unreachable. The
four call sites now pass `check_vma=False` literally.

`iris/cluster/controller/reads.py` declared three private tuples of task
states
that re-listed `ACTIVE_TASK_STATES`, `DISPATCHED_TASK_STATES`, and
`EXECUTING_TASK_STATES` from `task_state.py`, two of which the file
already
imported for other queries. Those queries now bind the canonical
frozensets, so
the SQL filters cannot drift from the sets the reconcile and scheduling
paths
use. Member lists are unchanged.

commits.message:
[nightshift] fix documentation drift (#9296)

> Flags renamed at dusk—
> the manual still points north
> to a deleted path.

The stall alert contract still described the execution-selecting phase
query as
reading the trailing hour, and a hard hang as holding its training
execution
anchor for an hour. Both windows became a day in #8568, when the phase
lookback
was widened so a run that went silent hours ago stays recognisable as
one that
stopped publishing rather than one that never started. An operator
reading the
contract to check enrollment would look at the wrong window. Record the
day, and
the ten-minute deferral to `TrainingTelemetryGone` that now fires first.

The same change left `_EXECUTION_LOOKBACK`, the constant the documented
hour came
from, unread; drop it and move the process-zero comment onto the
predicate it
explains.

Found by scanning `docs/ops/` against the code. The rest of that folder
— alert
titles, routes, reasons, thresholds, NCCL RAS outcomes and limits, and
the Iris
and Levanter symbols it names — matches the current tree.

The agentic lint review could not run here: every lane exited on `Not
logged in`,
so the `agentic-lint` label is withheld.

commits.author: loom-oa-dev[bot]
commits.message:
[rigging] Refresh distributed leases in a context (#9298)

Keep acquired distributed leases fresh with a shared `lease_refresh`
context
manager. Confirmed ownership loss stops further refresh attempts without
interrupting the caller, while other refresh failures retry with capped
exponential backoff. The refresher never attempts reacquisition because
a new
lease cannot restore exclusivity across an ownership gap.

Move Levanter's model cache off its private heartbeat and keep
completion-marker
publication inside the refreshed interval. A slow object-store marker
write
therefore remains covered by the heartbeat while the lease is healthy.

This is the Marin dependency for
[MarinSkyRL
#686](https://github.com/marin-community/MarinSkyRL/pull/686).

commits.author: karansag
commits.message:
[eval] Support pipeline-parallel vLLM serving (#9200)

Allow evaluation model YAMLs to request pipeline-parallel vLLM serving
with `serve.pipeline_parallel_size`. The GPU resource hint applies per
task: H100x8 with pipeline parallelism (PP) 2, tensor parallelism (TP)
8, and data parallelism (DP) 1 creates a two-task Iris gang using 16
GPUs. Validate TP × DP against GPUs per task before submission, keep
full-checkpoint host memory per task, and expose only the leader's
endpoint.

Pass tensor parallelism through the native multi-node launcher and keep
healthy followers running without a fixed lifetime; coordinator outages
still have bounded retries. Record resolved serving geometry and
`max_model_len` after endpoint startup, distinguishing them from
requested settings when startup fails. Single-task serving remains the
default.

Pythia PP2 × TP8 × DP1 completed GSM8K evaluation on two H100x8 tasks in
smoke run
`20260916-154135-pythia-31m-pipeline-tp8-pp2-smoke-gsm8k-0shot-db5f`
(Iris job
`/karan/eval-20260916-154135-pythia-31m-pipeline-tp8-pp2-smoke-9850`,
cluster `marin`, execution on `cw-us-east-02a`). Grug PP2 × TP1 × DP8
reached a serving endpoint and executed requests; its evaluation hit a
sample-count failure on base `e9a1f53d6a` and has not been rerun on the
updated base. The pinned Grug implementation rejects TP greater than 1.
Omit the start-rank flag for DP1 to avoid a startup validation error
from inferred external load balancing; see the [launcher
investigation](https://marina.oa.dev/echo/wiki/451).

The catalog includes a pinned GLM-5.2 AWQ INT4 configuration at PP2 ×
TP8 × DP1 with FP8 KV and a 1,048,576-token context limit. At
`gpu_memory_utilization: 0.83`, the limiting stage had 25.59 GiB
available KV against 26.14 GiB required. Changing only utilization to
0.85 increased that budget to 27.17 GiB and completed the two-example
GSM8K evaluation in [Iris run
20260918-152852-glm-5.2-awq-int4-pp2-1m-67da](https://iris.oa.dev/#/job/%2Fkaran%2Feval-20260918-152852-glm-5.2-awq-int4-pp2-1m-67da).
The catalog preserves this measured setting rather than leaving it in a
temporary smoke YAML.

Inspect the GLM gang without submitting it:

```sh
uv run python -m experiments.evaluation.cli launch --model glm-5.2-awq-int4-pp2-1m --evals gsm8k-0shot --limit 2 --dry-run
```

The GLM smoke validates startup configured for 1M context and short
requests, not actual full-length prompts or sustained concurrency. A
30-minute live soak and deliberate leader-kill recovery remain
unvalidated. A cold regional cache requires separate approval to mirror
roughly 474 GB from Hugging Face.

Part of #8215.
